item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las mi shig srung ba'i 'phyong chen gur rdzong chen mo
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ las kyi mtha' sgyur mi shig srung ba'i 'phyong chen srung ba'i gur rdzong chen mo 'di yang / gsas mkhar sgo dgu 'dus pa'i yang bcud/ 'd-i med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi dmar (smar) byang / mkhas pa de nyid kyis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la grub pa bsnyems kyang / phyis su sems can las 'phro zhan cing / ban btsun phrag dwogs dbang gis bon rnams bsnabs nas/ bka' rnams zab mo gter du gshegs te/ de dus mkhas pa stang chen gyis bon 'di shin tu zab par dgongs nas/ bka' gter gnyis su phyes te/ gter ni gsang ba'i brag rgya bo rus sbal gyen la 'gying ba 'dra ba la bka' rtags mtshal gyi g.yung drung dang / brda' yig gis rgyas btab nas sbas so/ man ngag 'di mkhas pa dmu tsha gyer med kyi thugs la gab bo/ phyis su rten 'brel skabs su babs pa'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub du bab pa'i gsas mkhar gsang ba'i sgrub pa 'di yang / dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' gsungs phab pa dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas/ bstan pa bzhag pa'i gnas su snang phyir du/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du/ rgod rje'i rus 'thob 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ming g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des dkar chag yi ge bris pa'o/ 'di bris 'gal 'khrul nyes skyon ci mchis pa/ gsas mkhar gsang ba'i lha la mthol lo bshags / dam can spar ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
